description:
MONITORING: Fetch Terraform deployment logs with pagination
Fetches logs from a running or completed Terraform deployment job.
For **completed jobs**: uses REST endpoint for instant retrieval (supports `tail` for server-side filtering).
For **running jobs**: streams via SSE with timeout-based pagination.

**PAGINATION** (running jobs only): Use `last_event_id` from the response to fetch more:
1. First call: `tflogs(session_id='...')` → get logs + `last_event_id`
2. Next call: `tflogs(session_id='...', last_event_id='...')` → get NEW logs only
3. Repeat until `complete: true` in response

**RESPONSE FIELDS**:
- `logs`: Array of log messages collected
- `last_event_id`: Pass this back to get more logs (pagination cursor, SSE only)
- `complete`: true if job finished, false if more logs may be available
- `total_logs`: total log entries before tail truncation

REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).
OPTIONAL: job_id to target a specific deployment (use tfruns to discover IDs),
timeout (default 50s, max 55s), last_event_id (for pagination), tail (return only last N entries)
⚠️ CONTEXT WARNING: Deploy logs can be hundreds of lines. Use tail: 50 for completed jobs to avoid blowing up the context window.

job_id.description: Optional. Target a specific job. Use tfruns to discover job IDs. When omitted, streams the latest job for the session.

last_event_id.description: Resume cursor for pagination. Pass back the last_event_id from a previous tflogs response to fetch only newer entries.

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing.

tail.description: Return only the last N log entries. Use 0 (or omit) for all available entries.

timeout.description: Max seconds to collect logs. Default 50, max 55.

name: tflogs

complete.description: True when the job has finished and no more logs will come.

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

last_event_id.description: Log cursor. Pass it back as last_event_id to fetch only newer entries.

logs_count.description: Number of log lines in this result.

session_id.description: Session ID these logs belong to.

title: Fetch Deploy Logs
